header: Step 1: Create and subscribe to an Amazon SNS topic
content:
Conﬁgure an Amazon SNS topic to serve as an event target for your new event rule.
To create an Amazon SNS target
1.
Open the Amazon SNS console at https://console.aws.amazon.com/sns/v3/home.
2.
Choose Topics and Create topic.
3.
For the job type, choose Standard, and name the job software-update.
4.
Choose Create topic.
5.
After the topic is created, choose Create subscription.
6.
For Protocol, choose Email. For Endpoint, enter an email address that you currently have
access to and choose Create subscription.

7.
Check your email account and wait to receive a subscription conﬁrmation email message.
When you receive it, choose Conﬁrm subscription.
